name: mlb-live-pbp
description: Static MLB scoreboard, game view and replay feed built on the public MLB StatsAPI. No build step: GitHub Pages serves the repository root; server.mjs is optional and never runs on Pages.

scripts.syntax: for f in assets/js/*.js server.mjs tools/*.mjs tools/lib/*.mjs tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:unit: node tools/page-render-test.mjs && node tools/review-test.mjs && node tools/reviews-feed-test.mjs && node tools/feed-fields-test.mjs && node tools/hit-model-test.mjs && node tools/verify-table-sources.mjs && node tests/selftest-verify.mjs
scripts.test:links: node tools/link-check.mjs && python3 tools/check-local-links.py && python3 tests/check.py
scripts.test: npm run syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run test:links
